completed_steps: 2. Audit WorldDriver.cs and InputDispatcher for IsOriginShiftFrameLockedForCurrentFrame and _shiftTargetsDirty
3. Locate why LateFrameTick freezes while PreSim advances during scene rebase / origin shift
4. Draft the surgical product fix that unlocks LateFrameTick without disabling origin shift safety
findings: InputDispatcher's LateFrameTick is blocked because SystemDispatcher.RunDispatcherLateFrame() has an early return `if (IsOriginShiftFrameLockedForCurrentFrame) return;`.
SystemDispatcher.RunDispatcherUpdate() calls PreSim BEFORE its own `IsOriginShiftFrameLockedForCurrentFrame` early return, so PreSim still advances while LateFrame is skipped.
_shiftTargetsDirty in HectonFloatingOrigin keeps the SceneRebaseTickLock alive (via TryPrepareShiftTargets/QueuePendingLoadedScene) if it evaluates to true, freezing the bootstrap lock.

The drafted fix injects the `ILateFrameTickable` loop directly inside the `IsOriginShiftFrameLockedForCurrentFrame` block before it returns. This prevents InputDispatcher from freezing (by pumping skipped inputs) without running any of the unsafe visual syncs or job fences that Origin Shift prevents.
